user.title: Add Modbus gateway
user.description: Enter the Modbus TCP gateway details. The integration will scan the RTU bus and create one Home Assistant device for each compatible meter.

data.limit_scan_range: Limit discovery to an address range

advanced.title: Advanced gateway settings
advanced.description: Auto detect tests both standard Modbus TCP and RTU-over-TCP by reading a real meter. A transparent gateway's RS485 baud and parity must already match the meters; those settings cannot be changed through generic Modbus TCP.

data.request_retries: Polling retries after the first attempt

scan_range.title: Modbus address range
scan_range.description: The default scan covers slave addresses 1 through 247. Restricting the range can make setup much faster.

progress.discover_devices: Scanning pass {pass}/{passes}, address {address}, using {transport}. Compatible meters found: {found}.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: The gateway address does not match this config entry.
abort.reconfigure_successful: Gateway settings and discovered meters were updated.

error.invalid_range: The first slave address must be less than or equal to the last slave address.
error.cannot_connect: Could not communicate with the gateway. Check its address, port, framing mode, and timeout, then try again.
error.no_devices_found: The gateway responded, but no compatible EM270 or EM280 meters were found. Check the RS485 settings, wiring, and slave-address range.

init.title: Polling options
init.description: Use Reconfigure on the integration entry to change the gateway address, framing mode, scan range, or rescan for meters.
